name: RENO detectors

technology.value: Two identical gadolinium-doped liquid-scintillator antineutrino detectors
technology.note: The 2012 discovery paper does not itself state the detectors' liquid-scintillator technology in the abstract text fetched; classified as liquid_scintillator based on the well-established RENO/Daya-Bay-family detector design referenced generally across reactor-neutrino experiments in this workstream, but no per-detector target mass was found in a fetched source this session.

summary.plain: Two identical tank-like detectors near and far from South Korea's Hanbit nuclear reactors, watching for antineutrinos.
summary.technical: Two identical Gd-doped liquid-scintillator antineutrino detectors at 294 m and 1383 m from the Hanbit reactor array; per-detector target mass not found in a source fetched this session.
